explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to plants classified VAI 414 days before and 146 days after the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows somatropin has been posted since 2023-01-06 and as of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on the list for 46 months.
FDA inspection 1167028 at Novo Nordisk A/S - KV ended 2021-11-18 classified VAI, 414 days before the shortage posting on 2023-01-06.
FDA inspection 1238387 at Novo Nordisk A/S - Hax ended 2023-06-01 classified VAI, 146 days after the shortage posting on 2023-01-06.
FDA inspection 1341150 at Novo Nordisk A/S - KV ended 2024-05-02 classified VAI, 482 days after the shortage posting on 2023-01-06.
Novo Nordisk, Inc. is listed as To Be Discontinued with initial posting date 2025-11-14 and related info stating discontinuation of manufacture.
Corvale General holds two NDCs for somatropin: Eli Lilly NDC 00002814701 with 69.91 units on hand and Novo Nordisk NDC 00169770321 with 64.42 units on hand.
The rule-based best option is to transfer 13 units from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would bring Corvale East to 7 days on hand while Corvale General retains two weeks.

Q-59da67.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%somatropin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%somatropin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-9ab66b.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('a774e1ae-3997-49ee-8b0e-99a2b315d409', '1058e17c-9261-459c-a3e6-fae38d196c14') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-e2c4d9.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%somatropin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-329fa4.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%somatropin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-bac05e.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%somatropin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%kit%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-3469c1.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3002807748', '3015545250', '3003150913') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-759cde.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3002807748', '3015545250', '3003150913') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-086263.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3002807748', '3015545250') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('novo nordisk a s hax', 'novo nordisk a s kv', 'lilly')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-7950c2.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('novo nordisk a s hax', 'novo nordisk a s kv', 'lilly', 'eli lilly', 'novo nordisk') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%somatropin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-395f5c.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00002814701', '00169770321')

Q-5aebf4.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%somatropin%'
